(* --- 2.1 Beam Loss Monitor (BLM) 2oo3 Voting --- *)

IF bBLM_ChA_Valid AND bBLM_ChB_Valid AND bBLM_ChC_Valid THEN
    (* All 3 channels healthy: compute true median *)
    IF (rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA >= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA AND rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA <= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA) OR
       (rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA >= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA AND rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA <= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA) THEN
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA;
    ELSIF (rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA >= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA AND rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA <= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA) OR
          (rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA >= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA AND rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA <= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA) THEN
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA;
    ELSE
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA;
    END_IF;
    bBLM_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;

    (* Inter-channel drift and discrepancy diagnosis *)
    IF (ABS(rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA - rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA) > c_rBLM_DiscrepancyTol_uA) OR
       (ABS(rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA - rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA) > c_rBLM_DiscrepancyTol_uA) OR
       (ABS(rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA - rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA) > c_rBLM_DiscrepancyTol_uA) THEN
        bBLM_Discrepancy_Warning := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: BLM Channel Discrepancy Warning *)
    ELSE
        bBLM_Discrepancy_Warning := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bBLM_ChA_Valid AND bBLM_ChB_Valid THEN
    (* Channel C failed: Degraded 1oo2 mode taking maximum for radiation safety *)
    IF rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA >= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA THEN
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA;
    ELSE
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA;
    END_IF;
    bBLM_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: BLM Channel C Hardware Failure *)
ELSIF bBLM_ChB_Valid AND bBLM_ChC_Valid THEN
    (* Channel A failed: Degraded 1oo2 mode *)
    IF rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA >= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA THEN
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA;
    ELSE
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA;
    END_IF;
    bBLM_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: BLM Channel A Hardware Failure *)
ELSIF bBLM_ChA_Valid AND bBLM_ChC_Valid THEN
    (* Channel B failed: Degraded 1oo2 mode *)
    IF rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA >= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA THEN

    ELSE
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA;
    END_IF;
    bBLM_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: BLM Channel B Hardware Failure *)
ELSE
    (* Dual or triple sensor failure: Total loss of BLM telemetry -> Fail-Safe Trip *)

    bFastAbortKickerTrigger := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Catastrophic BLM 2oo3 Sensor Loss *)

(* Overwrite voted BLM with primary input if hardware overrides are unassigned *)

    IF rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChB_pA >= rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChC_pA THEN

    bVac_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: UHV Gauge Channel A Failure *)
ELSIF bVac_ChA_Valid AND bVac_ChC_Valid THEN
    IF rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA >= rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChC_pA THEN
        rVoted_Vac_pA := rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Vac_pA := rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChC_pA;
    END_IF;
    bVac_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Bit 7: UHV Gauge Channel B Failure *)
ELSE
    bVacuumInterlockTrip := TRUE;
    bFastAbortKickerTrigger := TRUE;
    bFastGateValveCloseDemand := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Catastrophic UHV 2oo3 Sensor Loss *)
    iState := 90;

IF (rVacuumPressure_pA > 0.0) AND (rVoted_Vac_pA <= 0.001) THEN

       (ABS(rCryo_Level_ChB_pct - rCryo_Level_ChC_pct) > c_rCryo_DiscrepancyTol_pct) OR

(* Filter Stage 1: 50.0 Hz AC Mains Magnetic Leakage Notch *)

rN1_x1 := rBPM_Pos_X_nm;
rN1_y2 := rN1_y1;

(* Filter Stage 2: 300.0 Hz Power Converter Switching Harmonic Notch *)
rN2_y1 := c_rN2_b0 * rN1_y1 + c_rN2_b1 * rN2_x1 + c_rN2_b2 * rN2_x2 - c_rN2_a1 * rN2_y1 - c_rN2_a2 * rN2_y2;
rN2_x2 := rN2_x1;
rN2_x1 := rN1_y1;
rN2_y2 := rN2_y1;

(* Filter Stage 3: 43.5 Hz Girder Mechanical Vibration Resonance Notch *)
rN3_y1 := c_rN3_b0 * rN2_y1 + c_rN3_b1 * rN3_x1 + c_rN3_b2 * rN3_x2 - c_rN3_a1 * rN3_y1 - c_rN3_a2 * rN3_y2;
rN3_x2 := rN3_x1;
rN3_x1 := rN2_y1;
rN3_y2 := rN3_y1;

(* --- 3.2 Transverse Orbit Root-Mean-Square (RMS) Jitter Accumulator --- *)
(* Implements a 64-sample running circular buffer window (6.4 ms history at 10 kHz) *)
rOrbitSum_X := rOrbitSum_X - arrOrbitBuffer_X[iBufferIndex] + rN3_y1;
rOrbitSumSq_X := rOrbitSumSq_X - (arrOrbitBuffer_X[iBufferIndex] * arrOrbitBuffer_X[iBufferIndex]) + (rN3_y1 * rN3_y1);
arrOrbitBuffer_X[iBufferIndex] := rN3_y1;

iBufferIndex := iBufferIndex + 1;
IF iBufferIndex >= 64 THEN
    iBufferIndex := 0;
END_IF;

rOrbitMean_X := rOrbitSum_X / 64.0;
rOrbitVariance_X := (rOrbitSumSq_X / 64.0) - (rOrbitMean_X * rOrbitMean_X);
IF rOrbitVariance_X > 0.0 THEN
    rBeamOrbitRMS_nm := SQRT(rOrbitVariance_X);
ELSE
    rBeamOrbitRMS_nm := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rBeamOrbitRMS_nm > c_rOrbitTargetJitter_nm THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_1000; (* Bit 12: Beam Orbit RMS Jitter Exceeds 100 nm Specification *)
END_IF;

(* --- 3.3 SVD Modal Decomposition & Tikhonov Regularized ORM Inversion --- *)
(* Calculate regularized singular value inverse weights: s_i / (s_i^2 + lambda^2) *)
rReg_Gain_1 := c_rSVD_SingularValue_1 / ((c_rSVD_SingularValue_1 * c_rSVD_SingularValue_1) + (c_rSVD_Tikhonov_Lambda * c_rSVD_Tikhonov_Lambda));
rReg_Gain_2 := c_rSVD_SingularValue_2 / ((c_rSVD_SingularValue_2 * c_rSVD_SingularValue_2) + (c_rSVD_Tikhonov_Lambda * c_rSVD_Tikhonov_Lambda));
rReg_Gain_3 := c_rSVD_SingularValue_3 / ((c_rSVD_SingularValue_3 * c_rSVD_SingularValue_3) + (c_rSVD_Tikhonov_Lambda * c_rSVD_Tikhonov_Lambda));
rReg_Gain_4 := c_rSVD_SingularValue_4 / ((c_rSVD_SingularValue_4 * c_rSVD_SingularValue_4) + (c_rSVD_Tikhonov_Lambda * c_rSVD_Tikhonov_Lambda));

(* Project notched orbit measurement onto spatial eigenmodes *)
rModal_Coeff_1 := rN3_y1 * 0.707106;
rModal_Coeff_2 := rN3_y1 * 0.500000;
rModal_Coeff_3 := rN3_y1 * 0.353553;
rModal_Coeff_4 := rN3_y1 * 0.141421;

(* Synthesize regularized modal correction demand *)
rX_State_1 := (rModal_Coeff_1 * rReg_Gain_1 * 452.8) +
              (rModal_Coeff_2 * rReg_Gain_2 * 284.1) +
              (rModal_Coeff_3 * rReg_Gain_3 * 115.6) +
              (rModal_Coeff_4 * rReg_Gain_4 * 22.4);

(* --- 3.4 Vacuum Chamber Eddy Current Lead-Lag Dynamic Compensation --- *)
(* Compensates for the 350 us eddy shielding attenuation of the stainless-steel beam pipe *)
rX_State_2 := (rX_State_1 - rEddyLead_x1) / c_rTs_s; (* Estimated orbit velocity dx/dt [nm/s] *)
rEddyLead_x1 := rX_State_1;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.0 DISCRETE 4TH-ORDER STATE-SPACE MODEL & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZATION                           *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* Current State Vector: *)
(* x[k] = [ rX_State_1 (Orbit Error [nm]), rX_State_2 (Velocity [nm/s]), rX_State_3 (I_corr [A]), rX_State_4 (B_eddy [T]) ] *)
rX_State_3 := rCorrectorCurrent_A;

(* --- 4.1 One-Step Forward State Prediction: x[k+1] = A_d * x[k] + B_d * u[k] --- *)
rX_Pred_1 := (c_rAd_11 * rX_State_1) + (c_rAd_12 * rX_State_2) + (c_rAd_13 * rX_State_3) + (c_rAd_14 * rX_State_4) + (c_rBd_1 * rFastCorrectorDemand_A);
rX_Pred_2 := (c_rAd_21 * rX_State_1) + (c_rAd_22 * rX_State_2) + (c_rAd_23 * rX_State_3) + (c_rAd_24 * rX_State_4) + (c_rBd_2 * rFastCorrectorDemand_A);
rX_Pred_3 := (c_rAd_31 * rX_State_1) + (c_rAd_32 * rX_State_2) + (c_rAd_33 * rX_State_3) + (c_rAd_34 * rX_State_4) + (c_rBd_3 * rFastCorrectorDemand_A);
rX_Pred_4 := (c_rAd_41 * rX_State_1) + (c_rAd_42 * rX_State_2) + (c_rAd_43 * rX_State_3) + (c_rAd_44 * rX_State_4) + (c_rBd_4 * rFastCorrectorDemand_A);

(* Update Eddy Current internal state register *)
rX_State_4 := rX_Pred_4;

(* --- 4.2 Quadratic Cost Gradient Formulation --- *)
(* Objective: minimize J = 1/2 * (y_pred - y_ref)^T * Q * (y_pred - y_ref) + 1/2 * Delta_u^T * R * Delta_u + 1/2 * u^T * S * u *)
(* Gradient w.r.t control increment Delta_u: g = B_d[1] * Q * (rX_Pred_1 - 0.0) + S * rFastCorrectorDemand_A *)
rMPC_Gradient := (c_rBd_1 * c_rQ_Weight * rX_Pred_1) + (c_rS_Weight * rFastCorrectorDemand_A);

(* Approximate Scalar Projected Hessian: H = B_d[1]^2 * Q + R + S *)
rMPC_Hessian := (c_rBd_1 * c_rBd_1 * c_rQ_Weight) + c_rR_Weight + c_rS_Weight;

(* Solve 1D Unconstrained Step via Newton-Raphson: Delta_u* = - g / H *)
IF ABS(rMPC_Hessian) > 1.0E-06 THEN
    rMPC_DeltaU_Opt := - (rMPC_Gradient / rMPC_Hessian);
ELSE
    rMPC_DeltaU_Opt := - (rMPC_Gradient * 0.05); (* Fallback gradient descent *)
END_IF;

(* --- 4.3 Slew Rate Limiting & Actuator Envelope Bounding --- *)
(* Maximum slew per 100 us scan = c_rCorrectorMaxSlew_ApS * c_rTs_s = 5000 A/s * 0.0001 s = 0.50 A *)
IF rMPC_DeltaU_Opt > 0.50 THEN
    rMPC_DeltaU_Clamped := 0.50;
ELSIF rMPC_DeltaU_Opt < -0.50 THEN
    rMPC_DeltaU_Clamped := -0.50;
ELSE
    rMPC_DeltaU_Clamped := rMPC_DeltaU_Opt;
END_IF;

(* Apply feedback correction demand if FOFB is active *)
IF bFastOrbitActive AND (iState = 40 OR iState = 50 OR iState = 60) THEN
    rFastCorrectorDemand_A := rFastCorrectorDemand_A + rMPC_DeltaU_Clamped;

    (* Clamp within absolute bipolar power supply rating +/- 10.0 A *)
    IF rFastCorrectorDemand_A > c_rCorrectorMaxCurrent_A THEN
        rFastCorrectorDemand_A := c_rCorrectorMaxCurrent_A;
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_2000; (* Bit 13: Fast Corrector Amplifier Positive Saturation *)
    ELSIF rFastCorrectorDemand_A < -c_rCorrectorMaxCurrent_A THEN
        rFastCorrectorDemand_A := -c_rCorrectorMaxCurrent_A;
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_4000; (* Bit 14: Fast Corrector Amplifier Negative Saturation *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Closed-loop inactive: decay corrector current gradually to zero *)
    rFastCorrectorDemand_A := rFastCorrectorDemand_A * 0.995;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.0 SUPERCONDUCTING RF (SRF) CAVITY PHASE-LOCKED FIELD VECTOR CONTROL & MICROPHONICS                               *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* --- 5.1 In-Phase (I) and Quadrature (Q) Vector Demodulation --- *)
(* V_cavity = rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV, Phase = rSRF_PhaseError_deg *)
rSRF_I_Measurement := rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV * COS(rSRF_PhaseError_deg * 3.14159265 / 180.0);
rSRF_Q_Measurement := rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV * SIN(rSRF_PhaseError_deg * 3.14159265 / 180.0);

rSRF_I_Setpoint := c_rNominalCavityVoltage_kV;
rSRF_Q_Setpoint := 0.0;

rSRF_I_Error := rSRF_I_Setpoint - rSRF_I_Measurement;
rSRF_Q_Error := rSRF_Q_Setpoint - rSRF_Q_Measurement;

(* --- 5.2 LLRF Vector PI Regulators with Anti-Windup Clamping --- *)
rLLRF_Amp_Integrator := rLLRF_Amp_Integrator + (c_rLLRF_Ki_Amp * rSRF_I_Error * c_rTs_s);
IF rLLRF_Amp_Integrator > 1800.0 THEN
    rLLRF_Amp_Integrator := 1800.0;
ELSIF rLLRF_Amp_Integrator < 0.0 THEN
    rLLRF_Amp_Integrator := 0.0;
END_IF;

rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV := (c_rLLRF_Kp_Amp * rSRF_I_Error) + rLLRF_Amp_Integrator;
IF rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV > 1850.0 THEN
    rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV := 1850.0;
ELSIF rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV < 0.0 THEN
    rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV := 0.0;
END_IF;

rLLRF_Phase_Integrator := rLLRF_Phase_Integrator + (c_rLLRF_Ki_Phase * rSRF_Q_Error * c_rTs_s);
IF rLLRF_Phase_Integrator > 45.0 THEN
    rLLRF_Phase_Integrator := 45.0;
ELSIF rLLRF_Phase_Integrator < -45.0 THEN
    rLLRF_Phase_Integrator := -45.0;
END_IF;

rLLRF_PhaseSetpoint_deg := (c_rLLRF_Kp_Phase * rSRF_Q_Error) + rLLRF_Phase_Integrator;

(* --- 5.3 Heavy Beam Loading & Robinson Detuning Calculation --- *)
(* Optimal Robinson detuning: Delta_f = - (f0 * R_shunt * I_beam * sin(phi_s)) / (2 * Q_L * V_cavity) *)
IF rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV > 100.0 THEN
    rRobinsonDetuning_Hz := - ((c_rNominalRFFreq_MHz * 1.0E+06) * (c_rCavityShuntImpedance_MOhm * 1.0E+06) *
                                (rBeamCurrent_mA * 1.0E-03) * SIN(c_rSynchPhase_deg * 3.14159265 / 180.0)) /
                                (2.0 * c_rCavityLoaded_QL * (rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV * 1.0E+03));
ELSE
    rRobinsonDetuning_Hz := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Compute total microphonic and beam loading resonance detuning *)
rCavityDetuning_Hz := (rSRF_PhaseError_deg * (c_rNominalRFFreq_MHz * 1.0E+06) / (2.0 * c_rCavityLoaded_QL)) + rRobinsonDetuning_Hz;

(* --- 5.4 High-Voltage Piezoelectric Crystal Fast Mechanical Tuner --- *)
(* Active microphonics damping against ground vibration and cryo boiling pressure ripples *)
rPiezo_Integrator := rPiezo_Integrator + (c_rPiezo_Ki * rCavityDetuning_Hz * c_rTs_s);
IF rPiezo_Integrator > c_rPiezoMaxVoltage_V THEN
    rPiezo_Integrator := c_rPiezoMaxVoltage_V;
ELSIF rPiezo_Integrator < c_rPiezoMinVoltage_V THEN
    rPiezo_Integrator := c_rPiezoMinVoltage_V;
END_IF;

rPiezo_Command_Raw := (c_rPiezo_Kp * rCavityDetuning_Hz) + rPiezo_Integrator;
IF rPiezo_Command_Raw > c_rPiezoMaxVoltage_V THEN
    rPiezoTunerVoltage_V := c_rPiezoMaxVoltage_V;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_8000; (* Bit 15: Piezo Tuner Positive Rail Saturation *)
ELSIF rPiezo_Command_Raw < c_rPiezoMinVoltage_V THEN
    rPiezoTunerVoltage_V := c_rPiezoMinVoltage_V;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0001_0000; (* Bit 16: Piezo Tuner Negative Rail Saturation *)
ELSE
    rPiezoTunerVoltage_V := rPiezo_Command_Raw;
END_IF;

(* --- 5.5 Superconducting Cavity Thermal Quench Detection Interlock --- *)
(* Stored RF energy in cavity: U = (V_c^2) / (omega_0 * (R/Q)) ~ 0.5 * C * V^2 *)
rStoredCavityEnergy_J := ((rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV * 1.0E+03) * (rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV * 1.0E+03)) /
                          (2.0 * 3.14159265 * (c_rNominalRFFreq_MHz * 1.0E+06) * 120.0);

(* Power balance: P_forward - P_reverse should match cavity dissipation + beam power *)
rExpectedPowerDiss_kW := (rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV * rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV) / (c_rCavityShuntImpedance_MOhm * 1000.0) +
                         (rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV * (rBeamCurrent_mA * 0.001) * COS(c_rSynchPhase_deg * 3.14159265 / 180.0));
rPowerImbalance_kW := ABS(rSRF_ForwardPower_kW - rSRF_ReversePower_kW - rExpectedPowerDiss_kW);

(* Cryostat helium pressure time rate-of-change *)
rHeliumPressureDerivative := (rCryo_HePressure_mbar - rPrevHeliumPressure_mbar) / c_rTs_s;
rPrevHeliumPressure_mbar := rCryo_HePressure_mbar;

(* Quench criteria: major RF power divergence AND rapid cryo pressure spike *)
IF (rPowerImbalance_kW > c_rQuenchPowerDivergence_kW) AND (rHeliumPressureDerivative > 5.0) AND (iState >= 20) THEN
    iQuenchDebounceCounter := iQuenchDebounceCounter + 1;
    IF iQuenchDebounceCounter >= 10 THEN (* 1.0 ms persistent quench breakdown *)
        bSRF_QuenchDetected := TRUE;
        bRFCrowbarTrigger := TRUE;
        bFastAbortKickerTrigger := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: SRF Cavity Thermal Quench Breakdown *)
        iState := 90;
        RETURN;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF iQuenchDebounceCounter > 0 THEN
        iQuenchDebounceCounter := iQuenchDebounceCounter - 1;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.0 CRYOPUMPED ULTRA-HIGH VACUUM & BEAM LOSS MONITOR PROTECTION MATRIX                                            *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* --- 6.1 UHV Cold Cathode Pressure Calibration --- *)
(* Inverted Magnetron Townsend calibration: P [mbar] = (I_collector [A] / S_gauge)^(1/n) *)
IF rVoted_Vac_pA > 0.01 THEN
    (* Linearized Taylor approximation around 1.0e-10 mbar operating point *)
    rCalculatedVacuum_mbar := ((rVoted_Vac_pA * 1.0E-12) / c_rVac_GaugeSensitivity_ApM);
ELSE
    rCalculatedVacuum_mbar := 1.0E-11;
END_IF;

(* Compute dynamic vacuum pressure rate-of-change (leak or ceramic window puncture detection) *)
rVacuumPressureRate_pApS := (rVoted_Vac_pA - rPrevVacuumCurrent_pA) / c_rTs_s;
rPrevVacuumCurrent_pA := rVoted_Vac_pA;

(* Fast acoustic shockwave / vacuum leak interlock *)
IF (rVoted_Vac_pA > c_rVac_TripCurrent_pA) OR (rVacuumPressureRate_pApS > 250000.0) THEN
    bVacuumInterlockTrip := TRUE;
    bFastAbortKickerTrigger := TRUE;
    bFastGateValveCloseDemand := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: UHV Chamber Rapid Pressure Rupture Trip *)
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* --- 6.2 Beam Loss Monitor Radiation Dose Integration & Undulator Protection --- *)
(* Top-up injection blanking window: Booster kicker generates harmless 5 ms radiation burst *)
tInjectionBlankTimer(IN := bTopUpInjectionActive, PT := T#5MS);
bInjectionBlankingActive := bTopUpInjectionActive OR tInjectionBlankTimer.IN;

IF NOT bInjectionBlankingActive THEN
    (* Integrate ionizing radiation dose charge on undulator magnets: Q = int(I_blm dt) *)
    rIntegratedLossDose_uC := rIntegratedLossDose_uC + (rVoted_BLM_uA * c_rTs_s);

    (* Instantaneous peak loss trip *)
    IF rVoted_BLM_uA > c_rBLM_TripCurrent_uA THEN
        bBeamLossTrip := TRUE;
        bFastAbortKickerTrigger := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Instantaneous Beam Loss Peak Spill Trip *)
        iState := 90;
        RETURN;
    END_IF;

    (* Cumulative radiation dose trip to prevent permanent magnet demagnetization *)
    IF rIntegratedLossDose_uC > c_rBLM_MaxIntegratedDose_uC THEN
        bBeamLossTrip := TRUE;
        bFastAbortKickerTrigger := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Bit 7: Cumulative Undulator Radiation Dose Exceeded *)
        iState := 90;
        RETURN;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* --- 6.3 Cryomodule Liquid Helium Boil-Off Rate Estimator --- *)
(* Boil-off rate: derivative of liquid level multiplied by cryostat bath geometry factor *)
rCryoBoilOffRate_Lph := ABS((100.0 - rVoted_Cryo_pct) * 2.45);
IF rVoted_Cryo_pct < c_rCryo_MinHeliumLevel_pct THEN
    bSRF_QuenchDetected := TRUE;
    bRFCrowbarTrigger := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Bit 8: Liquid Helium Inventory Depletion Trip *)
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.0 MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) CONTROL MACHINE                                                        *)
(* Coordinates Conditioning, RF Field Ramp-Up, Storage Ring Injection, 10 kHz FOFB, and Safe Shutdown               *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPreviousState), PT := T#1000S);
iPreviousState := iState;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
       (* STATE 0: COLD STANDBY & SUBSYSTEM PRE-FLIGHT VERIFICATION                                                   *)
       (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bFastOrbitActive := FALSE;
        rFastCorrectorDemand_A := 0.0;
        rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV := 0.0;
        rPiezoTunerVoltage_V := 65.0; (* Pre-bias midpoint *)
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_FF00) OR 16#0000_0000;

        IF bEnable AND NOT bHardwareTripLatched AND bMasterClockLocked THEN
            iState := 10; (* Proceed to Vacuum Conditioning & Cryogenic Verification *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 10: VACUUM CONDITIONING & CRYOPUMPING VERIFICATION                                                  *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_FF00) OR 16#0000_000A;

        (* Require stable UHV vacuum < 5.0e-9 mbar and Cryo Level > 80% *)
        IF (rCalculatedVacuum_mbar < 5.0E-09) AND (rVoted_Cryo_pct >= 80.0) AND (rCryo_HePressure_mbar <= 25.0) THEN
            IF tStateTimer.ET >= T#2S THEN
                iState := 20; (* Proceed to SRF Cavity Field Ramp-Up *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            IF tStateTimer.ET > T#60S THEN
                dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0002_0000; (* Bit 17: Vacuum Conditioning Timeout Warning *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 20: SRF CAVITY FIELD RAMP-UP & LLRF VECTOR LOCK                                                     *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_FF00) OR 16#0000_0014;

        (* Controlled voltage ramp: 50 kV per second *)
        IF rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV < c_rNominalCavityVoltage_kV THEN
            rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV := rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV + (50.0 * c_rTs_s);
        ELSE
            rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV := c_rNominalCavityVoltage_kV;
        END_IF;

        (* Verify phase and amplitude lock stability *)
        IF (rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV >= (c_rNominalCavityVoltage_kV - 5.0)) AND
           (ABS(rSRF_PhaseError_deg) < 0.25) AND
           (ABS(rCavityDetuning_Hz) < 20.0) THEN
            IF tStateTimer.ET >= T#3S THEN
                iState := 30; (* Proceed to Beam Injection & Accumulation *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 80; (* Abort to controlled ramp down *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 30: BEAM INJECTION & DC STORAGE RING ACCUMULATION                                                   *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bFastOrbitActive := FALSE;
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_FF00) OR 16#0000_001E;

        (* Monitor beam accumulation from booster synchrotron *)
        IF rBeamCurrent_mA >= (c_rTargetCurrent_mA * 0.90) THEN
            IF tStateTimer.ET >= T#1S THEN
                iState := 40; (* Engage 10 kHz Fast Orbit Feedback *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF bBeamDumpCommand OR NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

    40: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 40: FOFB CLOSED-LOOP STABILIZATION ENGAGEMENT                                                        *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bFastOrbitActive := TRUE;
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_FF00) OR 16#0000_0028;

        (* Verify sub-micron orbit stability lock *)
        IF (rBeamOrbitRMS_nm <= c_rOrbitTargetJitter_nm) AND (ABS(rX_State_1) < 250.0) THEN
            IF tStateTimer.ET >= T#2S THEN
                iState := 50; (* Transition to User Beam Delivery *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        (* Check for feedback divergence *)
        IF rBeamOrbitRMS_nm > (c_rOrbitTargetJitter_nm * 3.0) AND (tStateTimer.ET > T#5S) THEN
            iState := 70; (* Fall back to Degraded Slow Feedback Mode *)
        END_IF;

        IF bBeamDumpCommand OR NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

    50: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 50: USER BEAM LIGHT DELIVERY (NOMINAL OPERATION)                                                    *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bFastOrbitActive := TRUE;
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_FF00) OR 16#0000_0032;

        (* Detect top-up injection kicker pulse to handle orbit transient *)
        IF bTopUpInjectionActive THEN
            iState := 60; (* Shift to Fast Orbit Transient Mitigation *)
        END_IF;

        (* Check if sensor failure requires degraded mode *)
        IF bBLM_Degraded_1oo2 OR bVac_Degraded_1oo2 OR bCryo_Degraded_1oo2 THEN
            bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
        ELSE
            bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;
        END_IF;

        IF bBeamDumpCommand OR NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

    60: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 60: FAST ORBIT TRANSIENT MITIGATION (TOP-UP INJECTION PULSE)                                        *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bFastOrbitActive := TRUE;
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_FF00) OR 16#0000_003C;

        (* Temporary gain scheduling: clamp corrector slew during kicker firing *)
        IF NOT bInjectionBlankingActive AND (tStateTimer.ET >= T#20MS) THEN
            iState := 50; (* Return to steady-state User Beam Delivery *)
        END_IF;

        IF bBeamDumpCommand OR NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

    70: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 70: DEGRADED SLOW FEEDBACK SAFE MODE                                                                *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bFastOrbitActive := FALSE; (* Disengage 10 kHz fast loop, run slow 10 Hz orbit correction *)

            bRFCrowbarTrigger := FALSE;
            bFastGateValveCloseDemand := FALSE;
            iState := 0; (* Transition to Cold Standby *)
        END_IF;
